Alger, 13 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 13, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data adopted deliberation number 05 on November 11, 2026. This text strictly regulates the processing and retention of personal information contained in application files within public and private organizations.
Encadrement du traitement des CV et des: Regulation of CV and sensitive data processing
L’Autorité nationale de protection des d: The National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPDP) has formalized the adoption of deliberation no. 05 on November 11, 2026. This measure aims to establish a strict regulatory framework governing the management of personal information appearing in resumes, whether submitted in paper or digital format. The regulation applies to all organizations in the public and private sectors, whether submissions are made directly or via recruitment platforms.
Ce texte s'appuie sur la loi n° 18-07 du: This text is based on Law No. 18-07 of June 10, 2018, relating to the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data. Pursuant to Article 18 of this law, the processing of so-called sensitive data remains in principle strictly prohibited, barring exceptions provided for by legislation.
Les recruteurs et employeurs ne peuvent: Recruiters and employers cannot require the presence of sensitive information in CVs without direct legal justification. The ANPDP also specifies that the fact that a candidate voluntarily mentions sensitive personal elements gives the employer no right to collect or exploit them. Receiving entities must redact or erase any non-essential information and ensure complete confidentiality of files during storage.
Pour les candidats, l'Autorité préconise: For candidates, the Authority recommends not mentioning sensitive personal information if it is not essential to prove professional skills or required by law for the applied position.
Le texte réglemente également le stockag: The text also regulates the temporary storage of applications. The ANPDP sets the maximum retention period for CVs and associated data to one full year from the closing of the recruitment procedure. Once this period has passed, organizations must mandatory destroy or permanently erase all received documents.
L'ANPDP a officiellement adopté la délib: The ANPDP has officially adopted deliberation no. 05 regulating personal data contained in CVs.
La collecte et le traitement des informa: The collection and processing of sensitive information remain strictly prohibited without direct legal justification.
Les employeurs publics et privés ont l'o: Public and private employers are obligated to redact or delete non-essential application data.
La durée de conservation maximale des do: The maximum retention period for application files is now set at one year.
